name: Town of Easton - Easton Utility and Sign poles
coverage: Easton, MA only. 7,019 points: Utility 3,547, Utility with light 1,505, Sign 1,307, Streetlight 592, Signal 62, Other 6. Planimetry 2017-04-12 (6,809) and 2014-04-20 (203).
license: No licence stated. Hub licenseInfo: 'For planning purposes only' with no warranty.
notes: Best single source: true labels and same-survey confusers (sign, signal, streetlight). OSM has 0 poles in Easton. Store derived facts with attribution. Ask the town before commercial reuse of the layer itself. Counts confirmed 2026-11-07.

name: City of Cambridge GIS - Utility Poles, Street Lights, Street Lights Not City Owned
coverage: Cambridge, MA. 1,712 UTILITY-POLE and 745 UNKNOWN from the April 2018 flight. 6,117 city-owned street lights (NSTAR records to 2005, being revised). Non-city lights from a 2010 flight, not field verified.
notes: Cleanest licence. Use street lights farther than 1.5 m from any utility pole as hard negatives. Treat UNKNOWN as unlabeled. OSM has 41 poles in Cambridge against 1,712 here.

name: Overture Maps base/infrastructure (power subtype, from OpenStreetMap)
coverage: Massachusetts, release 2026-10-21.0: power_pole 32,359; power_tower 32,779; power_line 4,561; minor_line 2,076; transformer 957 (538 tagged main, 12 distribution); substation 728; switch 3,038. Distribution poles nearly absent (Easton 0, Cambridge 41, Newton 103).
notes: Positives only. Absence is never a negative. Permitted route: GeoParquet on s3://overturemaps-us-west-2 or Azure, no account, range reads by bbox. Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors. Share-alike may apply if we redistribute a merged database.

name: City of Newton - Utility Poles
coverage: Newton, MA. 16,744 points. POINT_SUBT: P 13,872, RP 1,677, SL 1,064, HS 99, GS 32 (codes undocumented). Latest INSTALLDT 1998-10-05.
license: None stated on the service. A Harvard/MIT catalog copy is marked restricted.
notes: Large but old (Boston Edison era). Spot-check against the 2021 lidar and 2025 ortho before use. Confirm terms with the city. Negatives only if SL is confirmed to mean standalone streetlight.

name: Team labels on MassGIS 15 cm orthos (2025) and 3DEP lidar
coverage: Any site we label. Plan: 100-200 C&I sites.
license: Our own work over public-domain USGS lidar and MassGIS public imagery
notes: The only realistic source for pad-mounted transformers and switchgear. Two labelers per site, with evidence attached (permit kVA, release record, site plan). Corrections are new records, not overwrites. Label status: inferred until human_verified.

name: Duke Electric Transmission and Distribution Infrastructure Imagery Dataset (Bradbury et al.)
coverage: No Massachusetts coverage. US cities: Hartford CT, Tucson AZ, Colwich KS, Clyde NC, Wilmington NC, plus 9 cities abroad. About 321 km2, 28.1 GB.
notes: Hartford is the closest New England analogue for pretraining an imagery pole detector. Automated figshare download returned 403, so download by hand. Class names come from Duke team slides (not the primary doc). No pad-mounted transformers.

name: Electric Transmission Infrastructure Satellite Imagery Dataset for Computer Vision (GridTracer)
coverage: No Massachusetts coverage. Tucson AZ, Colwich KS, 5 New Zealand cities. About 264 km2, about 347 MB.
notes: Small and easy to try. Towers as boxes, lines as segments (per the GridTracer paper).

name: City of Cambridge Electrical Permits (hvtc-3ab9)
coverage: Cambridge, MA. 23,019 permits from 2018-08 to 2026-11, 805 commercial with existing service amps.
notes: Address-level evidence that service and transformer exist, plus OH or UG service. No position. Use as evidence on hand labels and as a site-level check for overhead service.

name: National Grid MA System Data Portal - feeders and hosting capacity services
coverage: National Grid Massachusetts territory
license: No terms found on the REST services. Portal terms not read.
notes: Feeder lines with a Phases field. Shows a feeder on the street, not overhead vs underground or equipment. Read the portal terms before storing. Keep as inferred context.

name: Mapillary map features (machine detections from street-level images)
coverage: Unknown. Not sampled in Holliston, Worcester, Somerville or Cambridge because a client token needs a sign-up.
license: CC BY-SA content (§3(b)). §5(a) bars unapproved data mining or robots and ignoring robots.txt. graph.mapillary.com/robots.txt disallows all. §11 attribution. §12 allows commercial training with anti-reidentification safeguards.
notes: No transformer, wire or cable class. Detections are model output, not ground truth. Hold until a legal reading of §5(a) against the robots.txt. A person may browse the site by hand to judge coverage.

name: MA DCR Streetlights
coverage: DCR parkways statewide. 10,346 points.
notes: Hard-negative confusers for the pole rule. Exclude any light within 1.5 m of a known utility pole.

name: MassDEP reportable releases (waste site and release lists)
coverage: Statewide. Only sites with a reported oil release.
license: State public record. mass.gov returned 403 to automated reads.
notes: Release tracking numbers tied to pad-mounted transformer fluid releases confirm a unit at an address (search excerpt: 131 Morse St, Foxborough). Person downloads the lists. Evidence for hand labels, not a training set.

name: EPA PCB Transformer Registration Database
coverage: National. Only registered PCB transformers, mostly old units.
notes: 2.06 MB PDF of the most recent active registrations by location. Rare hits at C&I sites. Fields not confirmed.

name: RMLD (Reading Municipal Light Dept) utility poles, North Reading
coverage: North Reading, MA. 4,150 poles with owner, maintainer and pole number.
notes: Service description: 'RMLD list of utility poles that have been geocoded'. Positions are likely address-geocoded, not surveyed, so not for location matching. Useful for per-street counts and ownership.

name: USGS 3DEP lidar: MA_CentralEastern_1_2021, MA_CentralEastern_2_2021, MA_Western_1_B24
coverage: Statewide
notes: Classes used: 1-7, 9, 17, 18, 20, 22. No ASPRS 13-16 (wire guard, conductor, tower, connector) and no pole class. Poles, wires and transformers sit in class 1 or are misfiled as vegetation. This is the detector's input, not a label source.

name: Geofabrik Massachusetts OSM extract
coverage: Massachusetts. 297 MB PBF, data to 2026-11-06T21:21Z.
notes: robots.txt returned 404 on both download.geofabrik.de and www.geofabrik.de on 2026-11-07, so no robots rule bars it today. The team's rule treats it as manual. A person downloads once. Same content as Overture, with raw tags.

name: OSM via Overpass API, planet.openstreetmap.org, taginfo
coverage: Massachusetts
notes: Overpass robots disallows /api/. The planet server allows only wget. taginfo disallows /api and /tags. Use Overture or the OSM on AWS buckets (osm-planet-us-west-2, no account) instead.

name: Daylight Map Distribution (Meta)
coverage: Global, frozen at v1.58 (November 2024)
notes: Discontinued and stale. Overture replaces it.

name: TTPLA aerial dataset (transmission towers and power lines)
coverage: No Massachusetts coverage. UAV video from two unnamed US states. 1,100 images at 3840x2160.
license: Repository listed as Apache-2.0. Image licence not stated.
notes: Oblique drone views of transmission lines. Poor match for nadir 15 cm orthos and distribution poles.

name: Toronto-3D mobile lidar
coverage: No Massachusetts coverage. About 1 km of road in Toronto.
notes: Non-commercial licence and mobile-lidar density. Research reference only.

name: DALES aerial lidar (University of Dayton)
coverage: No Massachusetts coverage. Surrey, BC.
license: Unconfirmed. Paper credits the City of Surrey Open Government Licence for source data.
notes: Closest public aerial-lidar analogue with pole and wire classes. Confirm the licence before any use.

name: Eversource maps and data
coverage: Eversource territory
license: Terms bar use (per the 2026-11-07 electrical-equipment research lane)
notes: Excluded.

name: KartaView street-level imagery
coverage: Unknown
license: Images CC BY-SA 4.0 (secondary sources). Terms page is a client-side app that I could not read.
notes: Detections found are traffic signs only. No pole or transformer detections. The API host did not respond.

name: Google Street View and Photorealistic 3D Tiles
coverage: Wide
license: Google terms bar object detection on Street View and 3D Tiles
notes: Excluded by the team's rule.
